faqs.question: Can you print our logo on bread and bakery paper bags?
faqs.answer: Yes. We review your logo, artwork coverage and print colors with the bag size and paper. Brown or white kraft can be considered for your design. Design support is available, and the printed sample is reviewed before bulk production.

faqs.question: What is the difference between SOS bags and paper bread bags?
faqs.answer: SOS bags in this range are supplied without handles and open into a flat base with expandable side gussets. Bread bags can be flat sleeves, gusseted loaf bags or long baguette formats, with a window where specified. Choose the construction around the filled product, rather than the product name alone.

faqs.question: What is the minimum order for custom printed bags?
faqs.answer: The general minimum is 1,000 bags. Your quotation confirms the quantity per size and artwork, paper, printing and packing. For large-volume or recurring orders, share the total requirement, quantity per design and proposed delivery batches.

faqs.question: Can you make bags for baguettes, loaves and pastries?
faqs.answer: Yes. Start with the product dimensions and packing method so we can review a long baguette sleeve, flat bread bag, side-gusset bag or square-bottom bakery bag. Include any fold-over closure, display window and clearance needed around the product.

faqs.question: How do we specify a bag for direct food contact?
faqs.answer: Tell us which food touches the paper, its packing temperature, grease or moisture exposure and expected packing time. The paper, inks, adhesive and any window or liner are reviewed for that application and delivery destination. Grease resistance is specified separately from the kraft paper color.

faqs.question: How long do sampling and production take?
faqs.answer: Custom samples take 7–15 days depending on the order. Production takes 7–45 days after sample approval, depending on the order. Sample fees depend on the design; orders over 5,000 pieces qualify for a refund of 50% of the sample fee. Shipping time is separate.

faqs.question: Do you quote for international delivery and repeat supply?
faqs.answer: Yes. Share your country, city or postal code, required receiving date and expected order frequency. Production is based in Vietnam. Shipping arrangements, delivery terms and any duties or taxes are confirmed in the quotation for your destination.

faqs.question: How are the bags checked and packed?
faqs.answer: Quality is checked at each production stage against the approved specification. Review printing, dimensions, folds, seams and the filled sample. Finished bags can be packed in cartons or shrink-wrapped bundles according to the order requirements.
